5399.title: Read-state events leave observed thread caches stale
5399.rootCauseOneLine: Read-state notifications invalidate observed list and sidebar queries without refetching or patching their read timestamps.
5399.proposedFix: Reuse the existing active-list refresh handler, preserve stale-only thread detail and archived lists, and remove the unused stale-only list handler.
5399.caveats: Cache-boundary reproduction repeated by the same investigator. Browser verification blocked by missing Chrome; native macOS and real cross-device UI journeys were not run.
